scenario.question: For constant source-defined surface propellant sales, how do revenue and construction timing affect company NPV?
scenario.valuation_date: commissioning, with operating receipts at ends of years 1 through 10

provenance.quantity_and_price: Sowers NIAC2020 Table4.9.3 commercial baseline, 1100t/year and500 source dollars/kg. Adopted for a conditional offtake exercise before viewing its comparative result.
provenance.years: Both source financial cases use10 operating years
provenance.rate: Kornuta source uses10%; supplied explicitly to Sowers because its native metric is IRR
provenance.windows: Annual-grid interpretation of Sowers four-year build and following deployment window, consistent with the existing timing_nonuniqueness.py. Shift original periods0..15 by5 to place commissioning at0. Endpoints bound all nonnegative allocations within these windows; endpoints are not claims about actual milestones.
provenance.currency: Both source cost years remain unknown. Unit cost multiplier is a conditional same-unit-of-account assumption, not a verified inflation conversion.0.8/1.2 are analyst stress multipliers, not estimated confidence bounds.
provenance.product_boundary: Producer surface offtake only; product equivalence across the full physical supply chains remains unverified. No orbital-delivery comparison or claim of Earth-versus-lunar competitiveness.
provenance.costs: Keep source-native aggregate capital and recurring costs fixed. No inferred capacity or equipment scaling. Kornuta's aggregate cash-flow model already holds the same plant costs across its customer scenarios.
provenance.sensitivity_values: Predeclared analyst stress cases;21.7% is also a cited historical hurdle rate. No probability distribution.
provenance.excluded: Taxes, terminal value, subsidies, construction operating expenses not separately supplied, and new physical architecture are not invented. Source cost boundaries remain different.

sowers_partial_identification.bound_scope: All nonnegative cost allocations inside declared annual windows, conditional on fixed source totals and no other cash flows

interpretation: Conditional financial comparison only. Missing currency normalization and product equivalence prevent a fully harmonized historical-model ranking.
